at-0001.title: Round money only with round_money
at-0001.content: Always round monetary Decimal results with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.

at-0005.title: Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc
at-0005.content: In ledgerly, normalize every incoming datetime with `ensure_utc` from `ledgerly.clock` before comparing or doing arithmetic (see `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py`). Apply it to both the argument and `sub.started_at`.

at-0006.title: Compute periods with timedelta floor division
at-0006.content: Compute subscription period boundaries the way `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py` does: `length = timedelta(days=sub.period_days)` then `n = (at - start) // length`, and derive times as `start + n * length`.

at-0007.title: Money operations take keyword-only idempotency_key
at-0007.content: Every function that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` and check it first, before state validation: if `ledgerly.audit.events()` already has an entry with that key, return the original record without reapplying. Pass `idempotency_key` into the `audit.record(...)` call (convention from incident INC-204).
